title: Ana Castela Visits Sete Quedas on Over 7-Hour Road Trip
seoTitle: Ana Castela Takes 7-Hour Road Trip to Sete Quedas
subtitle: The singer shows the journey, her customized pickup truck, and reuniting with family
excerpt: Ana Castela, 22, took an over 7-hour trip from Paraná to Mato Grosso do Sul in her R$ 670k Dodge Ram 3500 Limited Longhorn, and.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Singer Ana Castela shared on Tuesday's (8) Stories the over seven-hour road trip she took from Paraná to Sete Quedas, in the interior of Mato Grosso do Sul, to visit family.

Ana Castela's Trip to Mato Grosso do Sul

In her account, Ana explained that she has lived in Londrina, Paraná, for five years and returned to her home state to see her grandparents and aunt Kelli Cristiana. The journey lasted about seven hours, during which the artist chatted with followers and showed the roadside scenery.

Ana Castela's Dodge Ram 3500 Limited Longhorn

For the journey, Ana used her Dodge Ram 3500 Limited Longhorn, purchased in April this year and valued at over R$ 670,000. The 2026 model is described as the brand's most luxurious and powerful heavy-duty pickup available in Brazil, featuring an eight-speed automatic transmission, brown leather seats, wood trim, and an infotainment system measuring over 14 inches.

Customizations Made to the Vehicle

On her TikTok profile, the singer showed modifications to the power tonneau cover to make opening the tarp easier, adjustments to the clearance between the fenders and tires, the installation of lights on the wheel grilles, and decals with her name. Influencer César Rincon took part in the customizations.

Reunion with Family and Visit to Paraguay

Upon arriving, Ana was welcomed by her aunt and grandparents, and filmed the front of the house where she grew up, stating that the family reclaimed the land and moved back there. After resting, the singer took a ride to the border with the Paraguayan town of Pindoty Porã, showing the neighborhood in Paraguay.

Trip Details Shared on Stories

On Stories, Ana commented that she is from the countryside, thanked God, and invited her best friend Odorico Reis along for the journey. She also highlighted Sete Quedas' proximity to Paraguay, saying she was able to take a drive through the neighboring country during the visit.

With information from Globo.
